text: sd Icu_EnableWakeup | Channel #1 | Ecu State | Manager | Channel #1 | Channel #2 | ICU User ICU Driver | ICU driver is initialized: a) Module operates in Mode ICU_MODE_NORMAL b) Channel #1, wake up capable, default start edge = ICU_RISING_EDGE c) Channel #2, wake up capable, default start edge = ICU_RISING_EDGE d) Channel #1 notification in wake-up = disabled e) Channel #2 notification in wake-up = disabled f) ICU_NOTIFY_WAKEUP_REASON = ON | Icu input signal #1 and #2 are on low level. | because of disabled wakeup for Channel #1: - no wakeup-notification is called and also - no rising edge notification is called | Module operates in Sleep mode. | After the previous valid wakeup, the driver works a certain time in mode ICU_MODE_NORMAL | Icu_Init(ConfigPtr) | return | Icu_EnableNotification(Channel #1) | Icu_EnableNotification(Channel #2) | Icu_EnableWakeup(Channel #2) Request for enabling the wake-up capability of ICU channel #2 is stored | Icu_SetMode(ICU_MODE_SLEEP) Wakeup capability of ICU channel #1 will be disabled. | EcuM_ValidateWakeupEvent(events) Wake-up notification is called. | Icu_SignalNotification_Channel2(void) Rising edge notification | Icu_EnableWakeup(Channel #1) Re-enable the wake-up capability of Channel #1. | Icu_SetMode(ICU_MODE_SLEEP) | EcuM_ValidateWakeupEvent(events) Wakeup notification is called. | Icu_SignalNotification_Channel1(void) Rising edge notification
